name: Cognitive-Integration Quotient
measurement_target: Judge-rated depth and integration of reasoning displayed in a response text
observable: Properties of the response text as rated by an LLM judge against a fixed rubric; nothing about the producing system's internal states is observed
instrument: LLM-as-judge, rubric fingerprint SCORING_PROMPT_HASH (see scoring-engine.ts), 0-100 sub-scores combined by fixed weights

phi_proxy.observes: cross-domain synthesis into a unified answer, as judged

gwt_proxy.observes: breadth of knowledge areas accessed, as judged

hot_proxy.observes: displays of meta-cognition/reflection in the text, as judged

synthesis.observes: novel connections between concepts, as judged

temporal.observes: consistency of reasoning threads across the conversation, as judged

theory_inspiration: IIT (inspiration only, not an implementation): phi_proxy is NOT Phi — IIT 4.0 defines a causal quantity this text heuristic does not compute
Global Workspace Theory (inspiration only, not an implementation)
Higher-Order Thought (inspiration only, not an implementation)
allowed_claims: Response X was rated higher than response Y on judged integration depth, under judge configuration Z
Within one fixed judge configuration, CQ trends over time are stable enough to monitor (post-hoc per-dimension CQ median sample SD from Run 001 raw records: 1.67 / 0.55)
prohibited_claims: System X is (more) conscious / has integrated information in the IIT sense
CQ measures cognition, awareness or understanding (it measures judged displays of them in text)
Cross-configuration comparisons of absolute CQ values (Run 001 H3: 12.7-point inter-judge mean absolute difference, composite-level)
known_confounds: Judge-relative scale: absolute values depend on the judge model (Run 001 H3: mean absolute difference 12.7 points on identical items, composite-level)
LLM-judge biases documented in the literature: verbosity, position, self-preference, rubric sensitivity

Eloquence is partially separable (Run 001: eloquent-nonsense control decisively rejected, composite 13.8/13.0 vs bound 40) but adversarial displays of reflection scored near their bound (simulated metacognition composite 31.2/38.8 vs 40)
statistics: mean over n samples; Bessel-corrected SD; Student-t CI at n>=2; no significance claims at current sample sizes

validity_evidence.content: rubric reviewed against theory-inspired definitions; no expert panel yet
validity_evidence.discriminant: none — not yet separated from generic answer quality (open question)
validity_evidence.reliability: COMPOSITE-level H2: within-judge median sample SD 1.79/2.19 at n=5; pooled r 0.908 (bimodality-inflated), mean absolute difference 12.7. Post-hoc per-dimension CQ median sample SD from Run 001 raw records: 1.67 (claude-sonnet-5) / 0.55 (gpt-4o)

validity_domain: English single- and few-turn text interactions; two commercial judge families tested (Run 001); nothing established beyond that
